labelling_rationale.drink-carton_vitasoy-choc: 紙盒飲品（Tetra Pak）— 可回收物，需沖淨壓平
labelling_rationale.drink-carton_vitasoy-oolong: 紙盒飲品（Tetra Pak）— 可回收物，需沖淨壓平
labelling_rationale.drink-carton_vitasoy-jasmine-soy: 紙盒飲品（Tetra Pak）— 可回收物，需沖淨壓平
labelling_rationale.lens-wipe_sachet: 濕紙巾複合膜包裝（可含消毒液）— 不可回收，歸入其他垃圾
labelling_rationale.candy-wrapper_bonbons: 糖果獨立包裝紙／複合膜 — 不可回收，歸入其他垃圾
labelling_rationale.candy-wrapper_haribo: 糖果獨立包裝紙／複合膜（鍍鋁）— 不可回收，歸入其他垃圾
labelling_rationale.chip-can_wise-cottage-fries: 複合罐（紙筒＋金屬底＋膠蓋）— 香港混合材質薯片罐一般不可回收，歸入其他垃圾
labelling_rationale.biscuit_ovaltine: 塑膠包裝袋／複合材質零食袋 — 香港一般不算乾淨回收，歸入其他垃圾
labelling_rationale.drink-carton_vitasoy: 紙盒飲品（Tetra Pak）— 屬可回收物（清潔壓平後交紙盒回收）

known_risks: hand visible in most frames — model may learn hand/arm as a feature; future sessions should include object-only shots
fixed background (same desk + monitor) — background-shortcut risk documented in docs/issue12/field-probe/metrics.md
some frames out of focus / motion blur — kept deliberately, real usage has these
split_rule: session-based split only; never random. s1 currently exists; add s2/s3 with different background/light before training.
